{"command": "mkdir -p /tmp/g2g_scripts; cat > /tmp/g2g_scripts/a.py <<'E'
import json,glob,collections,sys,os
root=sys.argv[1]
rows=[];seen=set();dups=0
for f in sorted(glob.glob(root+'/*/*.jsonl')):
    for l in open(f):
        d=json.loads(l); rows.append(d)
ts=sorted(d['timestamp'] for d in rows);print(ts[0],ts[-1])
asst=[d for d in rows if d['type']=='assistant']
rid=collections.Counter(d['requestId'] for d in asst);print('dup reqids',sum(1 for v in rid.values() if v>1))
P=collections.defaultdict(lambda:collections.Counter())
days=collections.Counter(d['timestamp'][:10] for d in rows)
print(sorted(days.items()))
seen=set()
for d in asst:
    if d['requestId'] in seen: continue
    seen.add(d['requestId'])
    p=os.path.basename(d['cwd']); c=P[p]
    u=d['message']['usage']; c['in']+=u['input_tokens'];c['out']+=u['output_tokens']
    c['cc']+=sum(u['cache_creation'].values());c['cr']+=u['cache_read_input_tokens'];c['req']+=1
    for b in d['message']['content']:
        if b['type']=='tool_use':
            c['tool_'+b['name']]+=1
            i=b['input']
            if b['name']=='Edit':
                c['add']+=i['new_string'].count('\n');c['del']+=i['old_string'].count('\n')
            if b['name']=='Write': c['wlines']+=i.get('content','').count('\n')
            if b['name']=='Bash': c['bash']+=0
    c['sessions']+=0
for p,c in P.items():print(p,dict(c))
S=collections.defaultdict(set)
for d in rows:S[os.path.basename(d['cwd'])].add
